page.overview:
What is Copper Ingot?

Copper ingots are metal ingots that can be obtained by smelting up raw copper or occasionally dropped by drowned that was killed by the player or a tamed wolf. They are used to craft armor, tools, and other decorative copper variant blocks.

Copper ingots can be obtained by smelting raw copper or copper ore in a furnace or blast furnace.

When killed by a player or a tamed wolf, a drowned has a 11% () chance of dropping a copper ingot. With the Looting enchantment, the chance can be increased to 13% () with Looting I, 15% () with Looting II, and 17% () with Looting III.

When killed by a player or a tamed wolf, a copper golem will drop 2-3 copper ingots. It's not affected by Looting enchantment.
